messages:
Maya R.: hey team, first week q: where should i post different onboarding asks? laptop, VPN, calendar invites, and any bot settings? trying not to spam channels
Theo: welcome Maya! :wave: short map: IT tickets via /helpdesk for hardware, #people-ops for badge/calendar, #help for quick public Qs, and use team channels for product/infra access requests
Jia (IT): for laptops and software installs open a helpdesk ticket. slash command: `/helpdesk new "New laptop - Maya R." --priority=normal` then DM me if you need faster turnaround
Alejandro (People Ops): for calendar invites, badge access, and benefits questions ping #people-ops or DM me. put your start date in the message and we9ll sync with facilities
Maya R.: thanks! bots: i see a lot in the sidebar. safe to mute some? how to decide what to keep unmuted
Theo: keep onboard-bot, calendar-bot, and security-notify on. mute deploy-bot and ci-bot unless you9re oncall or working on deploys. to mute: open the app from the channel header -> App details -> Notifications -> Mute
Jia (IT): also for access requests to repos or infra, post in the owning channel (e.g., #eng-infra) with GitHub username + reason. adding a manager cc helps speed approval
Alejandro (People Ops): etiquette refresher: 1) start a thread for follow-ups instead of new messages, 2) avoid @here unless urgent, 3) keep asks short with one-line summary + necessary links, 4) use DMs for sensitive info like laptop serials or personal details
onboard-bot: Welcome Maya R.! :tada: Please confirm your workstation, calendar, and badge steps in this thread when completed
Maya R.: got it, opening the helpdesk ticket and posting the badge request in #people-ops. saved the mute steps too, thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
